translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Aa malo, Aa malo, yaye Sayun,
jiw badi motegno!
Rwak lepi mabeyo,
yaye Jerusalem dala maduongʼ maler.
Nimar joma ok oter nyangu kendo mogak,
ok nochak odonji e Jerusalem kendo.
Tengʼ buru momaki oko;
aa malo kendo ibed piny e kom duongʼ, yaye Jerusalem.
Gony nyoroche motwe ngʼuti,
yaye in Nyar Sayun manie twech.

content: Nimar ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho:

content.text: “Nongʼiewi maonge chudo moro,
omiyo ibiro wari ma ok ochulie pesa.”

content: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho:

content.text: “Mokwongo joga nodhi Misri mondo odagie,
bangʼe jo-Asuria nosandogi.
“Joga okaw nono maonge gima ochul
kendo joma tiyogi koro goyonegi siboi,”
Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
“Kendo kinde duto giyanyo nyinga.
Kuom mano joga biro ngʼeyo nyinga;
kendo odiechiengno giningʼe maber ni an,
ema ne asewacho wechegi chon.
Adier, en An.”
Mano kaka en gima ber neno tiend joote maringo ewi gode
kakelo wach maber, mar kwe, mar resruok,
kod mar warruok kagiwachone Sayun niya, “Nyasachu olocho!”
Winjuru! Jorito mau mondo okog matek;
giduto gikok nikech gimor.
Ka Jehova Nyasaye noduog Sayun,
to ginine lochne ayanga.
Weruru matek gimor un duto,
un kuonde mokethore mag Jerusalem,
nimar Jehova Nyasaye osehoyo chuny joge,
osereso Jerusalem.
Jehova Nyasaye biro rieyo bade maler ka ogendini duto neno,
kendo tungʼ piny ka piny none warruok mar Nyasachwa.
Wuoguru, wuoguru, auru kanyo!
Kik umul gima ochido!
Wuoguru kuome mondo ubed maler,
un mutingʼo gik ler mar Jehova Nyasaye.
To ok unuwuogi kurikni kata ka uringo;
nimar Jehova Nyasaye notel nyimu,
ee Nyasach Israel bende nodongʼnu chien.
Ne, jatichna biro tiyo gi rieko;
enotingʼe malo moloyo kimiye duongʼ mangʼongo.
Mana kaka ji mangʼeny nobwok konene,
kite ne olokore makoro ne ok ochal ka dhano,
kendo kite nokethore mopogore gi kit dhano,
omiyo ogendini mangʼeny nobwogi
kendo ruodhi nolingʼ thi nikech en.
Nimar gik mane ok owachnegi, gibiro neno,
kendo gik mapok giwinjo, nodonjnegi.
